semantics.0: Original reactive controller without a limiter
semantics.positive: Read controller state and change any button only every N native frames
semantics.clocks: Elapsed native frames continue advancing during held inputs
semantics.decoding: Native telemetry/decoding continues; held frames never enter the controller

uncertainty.unit: seed, keeping all four matchups and all control modes together
uncertainty.intervals: Pointwise exploratory 95% intervals; no multiple-comparison correction

evidence.contents: All 160 period rows, frozen Python sources, collector and analysis; no ROM/save-state bytes

limitations: Untuned control-rate comparison against the built-in CPU, not trained ML or human players.
Fixed first-period starts, two roster pairs, and ten seed clusters.
Same seeds as the earlier 60/15 Hz comparison, rerun in all four modes.
Selective manual goalie control; not an ablation isolating skating, goalie or finishing.
Precise RAM observations at allowed updates, no additional inference latency.
Native shot/goal/one-timer counters support outcomes; repeated diagnostic request counts are not independent actions.
